description:
The Silverpush Android Video Player SDK enables seamless integration of live streaming and video-on-demand (VOD) playback within Android mobile applications. Designed for performance and scalability, the SDK abstracts complex video workflows such as player initialization, adaptive bitrate streaming, ad insertion, and media session management—allowing developers to focus on delivering engaging user experiences instead of managing low-level playback infrastructure.
A key capability of the SDK is its support for dynamic ad insertion during scheduled commercial breaks in live streams, ensuring smooth ad playback without disrupting the viewing experience. The player also includes comprehensive content and advertising analytics, providing actionable insights into performance, engagement, and monetization.
